summary: StudentPayHistory manages a student’s pay history records in the HSPnet system, supporting create, update, delete, and search operations. It tracks key fields related to employment, pay, designation, and appointment status, and provides logic for formatting, inheritance, and language localization.
purpose: To record, update, and retrieve pay history records for students, including details on employment class, designation, status, pay level, year, and fixed-term appointments, facilitating business workflows and compliance.

workflows.name: Add Pay History Record
steps: User/system calls Add with required parameters
Parameters added to DB procedure StudentDetailsPayHistoryAdd

workflows.name: Update Pay History Record
steps: User/system calls Update with required parameters and record ID
Parameters added to DB procedure StudentDetailsPayHistoryUpdate

workflows.name: Delete Pay History Record
steps: User/system calls Delete with record ID
Parameters added to DB procedure StudentPayHistoryDelete

workflows.name: Search Pay History Records
steps: Parameters added to DB procedure StudentDetailsPayHistorySearch
Records retrieved and filled via FillEntry

workflows.name: Search by Record ID

business_rules: If CreatedByUserID is 0, return automated process string for user display
For language localization, use alternate language fields if UseAltLanguageFields is true
validations: FillEntry defaults fields if no recent record exists
StatusOrPayLevelReason returns StatusReason if present, else PayLevelReason
calculations: CreatedByUserLong and CreatedByUserShort are both calculated/display fields
EffectiveDateFormatted and FixedTermAppointmentFormatted are calculated for UI
conditions: Alternate language fields used if UseAltLanguageFields is true
If StatusReasonCodeID == 0, PayLevelReason used in StatusOrPayLevelReason
system_behavior: Supports CRUD on pay history records with stored procedures
Fills entity from DB using FillEntry
Defaults values if no recent record found
dependencies: DB procedures: StudentDetailsPayHistoryAdd, StudentDetailsPayHistoryUpdate, StudentPayHistoryDelete, StudentDetailsPayHistorySearch, StudentDetailsPayHistorySearchID, StudentDetailsPayHistorySearchMostRecent
exceptions: If no recent entry found, defaults are applied
content_gaps: No explicit field-level validation rules (e.g., required fields, type checks)
No explicit error handling or edge cases for DB failures
No description of permissions or role-based access
No description of UI or API integration details
